<thought>We have the test evaluation metrics (mae, rmse, r2, feature_importance) from the evaluate_xgboost_model result and need cross‑validation results. Perform 5‑fold cross‑validation on the training CSV using the same hyperparameters, then write a JSON file containing both the test_set_evaluation and cross_validation_results as required.</thought>
<action>perform_cross_validation</action>
<action_input>{
    "train_data_path": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_nitrides_trial_0/train.csv",
    "target_column": "formation_energy_per_atom",
    "cv_folds": 5,
    "hyperparameters": {
        "n_estimators": 200,
        "max_depth": 8,
        "learning_rate": 0.1,
        "subsample": 0.8,
        "colsample_bytree": 0.8,
        "reg_alpha": 0.1,
        "reg_lambda": 0.1
    }
}
</action_input>
